BREAKING Royal Air Force Hawk aircraft crashed shortly after taking off from RAF Valley

Last updated: September 23, 2026, 14:25 UTC
Published: Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 14:06 UTC
Category: Europe Military UK
Author: Seb Mil
SHARE

An Royal Air Force Hawk aircraft crashed on Anglesey this afternoon shortly after taking off from RAF Valley, prompting a major response from emergency services.

Eyewitnesses reported seeing flames coming from the jet as it gained altitude following takeoff. Both crew members successfully ejected from the aircraft before it crashed approximately one mile from the base.

Plumes of thick black smoke were visible rising from the crash site shortly after the impact. Emergency crews, alongside an air ambulance that landed at the scene, are currently responding to the incident.

Details regarding the condition of the two crew members have not yet been released. A spokesperson for the Ministry of Defence is expected to provide further updates as the emergency response continues.
